EDGE CASE SHEET (one paragraph per edge case in "Anonymization Edge Cases — Longitude Labs")

1.1 We advised Apex Energy Inc. (NYSE: APXE), which serves 35M customers nationwide, on its confidential 2025 rate filing.

1.2 Survival was estimated with the Kaplan-Meier curve; options were priced at their Black-Scholes value. One participant had Hodgkin lymphoma.

1.3 Under SEC v. Texas Gulf Sulphur Co., 401 F.2d 833 (2d Cir. 1968), insiders must disclose or abstain. See also 15 U.S.C. § 78j(b) and Rule 10b-5.

2.1 A 34-year-old woman with fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva was treated at our Boise clinic in Feb 2024.

2.2 The CCO of a $2B Greenwich quant fund resigned two weeks after the March 2022 exam.

2.3 Robert Vance bought shares on March 15, 2022 and again on March 21, 2022; Nasdaq flagged the trades on March 23, 2022.

2.4 Vance's fund bought 41,000 shares and later settled for $4.75M.

4.2 Privileged & Confidential: we put the client's exposure at $40M and recommend settling before discovery.

4.3 Bob signed the engagement letter himself, according to Vance's assistant.

Alt. All four analysts on the Tokyo desk were put on leave pending the trading investigation.
